author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Two people were taken to a hospital after a tree fell across Church Avenue and struck an occupied vehicle in Warwick on Thursday afternoon, police said.

Emergency crews received the report at about 3:22 p.m. Firefighters helped all three people inside the vehicle get out safely. Two occupants were transported with injuries described as not life-threatening, while the third person did not require the same reported level of treatment.

Authorities did not immediately identify the occupants or provide a detailed description of the vehicle’s damage. The source report also did not specify what caused the tree to fall, whether weather or the tree’s condition played a role, or how long the road was affected.

Police said the incident remained under investigation. The limited initial account establishes that the vehicle was occupied when the tree came down and that emergency personnel were able to reach everyone inside. Additional findings, including any traffic impacts or property assessment, had not been announced in the report.
dek: Firefighters helped three occupants out of the vehicle after a tree came down across Church Avenue Thursday afternoon.
headline: Two hospitalized after tree falls on vehicle in Warwick
